why: Maintained SDK/config/SNS/SigV4 and Redis clients; known established Cassandra/AMQP pins reused. Redis requires YAML3.0.5; new service isolated module does not change older services. Existing upstream SQS endpoints use Query/XML; preserve this supported provider protocol with narrow GetQueueUrl/ReceiveMessage/DeleteMessage codec using maintained SDK credentials/SigV4, standard HTTP/XML and verified TLS; do not add obsolete SQS SDK or custom cryptography. AWS officially supports Query and JSON protocols; JSON transport equivalence is not required for configured legacy fake/custom endpoints.
checks: Actual strict module verification, module-level vulnerability scan and license check/report passed; exact mod/sum/check receipts retained. Candidate full-module checks still required.
limitations: go-licenses reports native assembler inspection warnings for xxhash/x/sys; these dependencies licensed BSD/MIT; module vulnerability scan covers graph. No runtime candidate compatibility claim.
